stories.title: Barnwell predicts five NFL teams to improve in 2026: More wins for the Giants, Chiefs and Lions?
stories.summary: Can the Giants and Jets improve on their awful 2025 records? Will the Chiefs, Lions and Ravens all make it back to the playoffs?

stories.title: Projecting every team's 53-man roster for this season

stories.title: TE to go from Browns to LSU in historic twist
stories.summary: The Browns are waiving tight end Dae'Quan Wright, who has an agreement in place for the 2026 season to play for LSU if he clears waivers, agents Drew Rosenhaus and Kyle Lincoln told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Kanter Freedom tossed after clash with Cloud
stories.summary: Ex-NBA player Enes Kanter Freedom was ejected from Sunday's game between the Fever and the Sky after a verbal altercation with Chicago's Natasha Cloud.

stories.title: Vrabel: Pats' depth barb not shot at front office
stories.summary: When Patriots coach Mike Vrabel said "I do not think we have a very deep team" on Saturday, he was highlighting why Drake Maye, A.J. Brown and other starters haven't played in a preseason game. But was Vrabel also sending a message to the front office?
